Added two documents (Direct Testimony Document and
Exhibit List Document) to Kiteworks and Egnyte
My name is Delta Lynn Gahimer Party No 525, and I am an intervenor in this
proceeding. I submitted my Direct Testimony on the PUCT docket on time. I was
not aware that the testimony document needed to be filed elsewhere to be
considered. I had talked to the PUCT public relations office shortly after I filed
and was told I did not need to do anything further.

I joined today’s, 6/5, prehearing conference and realized I had not done all needed.
I did ask the judge in the prehearing to allow me to enter my testimony late. She
said go ahead and file them now.

So I have submitted two documents to both the Kiteworks and Egnyte platforms
under my Delta Gahimer folder. One is a document listing my exhibit and the
other is my direct testimony document (#3869 on the PUCT interchange).

Please accept these documents for the merits hearings next week.

Respectfully Submitted –
